note: J'aurai besoin is explicitly future; English simple present is less exact.
proposed_target: J'aurai besoin de toi ici demain.
proposed_english: I will need you here tomorrow.

note: aimer a person means love; English incorrectly says 'like'.
en refers to it/of it; it does not specifically mean 'this'.
proposed_target: Je pense qu'on en a besoin.

note: avoir tort is naturally 'be wrong'; English 'be incorrect' is unnecessarily unnatural for this learner sentence.
proposed_target: Je crois que vous avez tort.

note: bien entendu here means heard correctly/well; English drops that nuance.
proposed_target: Je crois que vous m'avez bien entendu.
proposed_english: I think you heard me correctly.

note: rentrer chez moi means go/return home, not necessarily come home.
